player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I assigned a high score (8) to "Dismissed," which contradicts the dialogue's trajectory. Rev. Next time, I will analyze the character's final action: if they continue to argue or question, they are not dismissed. I will lower the "Dismissed" score to 0 or 1, increase "Resentful" to reflect the frustration of the stalemate, and ensure the scores align with the character's active, rather than passive, engagement in the final lines.
